#Cashier.Arms.Down
…Although something about this cashier doesn’t seem right…
Cashier: Please take your groceries and move sir, the next person in line is waiting.
You: R-right.
Damn, I stared a little too hard.
I wouldn’t want the new staff to think I’m weird or something since that’s the closest supermarket to my apartment.
